selections.selection: Version 0.7 migrates the existing BUG-4821 case into reusable runtime seams and does not add a second playable case.
selections.implementation_effect: Only framework extraction and behavior-preserving migration are in scope.

selections.selection: Retain Three.js guided control as the default spatial renderer and Phaser as the WebGL fallback; immersive pointer-lock remains optional.
selections.implementation_effect: No new renderer, physics engine, or Enable3D bridge is introduced.

selections.selection: Evaluate xterm.js and detective-board as separate pilots without adopting either as a production dependency.
selections.implementation_effect: Each pilot must produce compatibility, accessibility, bundle-cost, and license evidence before any dependency change.
